# LogicSwitch:maxDuration

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the logic switch max duration.

```lua
local maxDuration = ls:maxDuration([maxDuration])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `maxDuration` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns

maxDuration (integer)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
ls = model.getLogicSwitch(0)
ls:maxDuration(100)
```
